specs.title: SCN-001: The catalogue lists every book with all its fields

steps.title: When a client requests GET /BookStore/v1/Books
Then the answer is 200 with a books list
And every entry has isbn, title, subTitle, author, publish_date, publisher, pages, description and website

specs.title: SCN-002: Looking one book up returns its catalogue entry

steps.title: Given the catalogue entry of 9781449325862
[SEED] the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When a client requests GET /BookStore/v1/Book?ISBN=9781449325862
Then the answer is 200 with the same data as the catalogue entry

specs.title: SCN-003: The Book Store page lists every catalogue book

steps.title: Given the books GET /BookStore/v1/Books returns
[SEED] the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I open the Book Store page
Then every one of them is listed with its title, author and publisher

specs.title: SCN-004.1: The search box filters by title, author or publisher ("javascript")

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page
When I type "javascript" in the "Type to search" box
Then exactly these books are listed: Learning JavaScript Design Patterns, Speaking JavaScript, Programming JavaScript Applications, Eloquent JavaScript, Second Edition

specs.title: SCN-004.2: The search box filters by title, author or publisher ("zakas")

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page
When I type "zakas" in the "Type to search" box
Then exactly these books are listed: Understanding ECMAScript 6

specs.title: SCN-004.3: The search box filters by title, author or publisher ("No Starch")

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page
When I type "No Starch" in the "Type to search" box
Then exactly these books are listed: Eloquent JavaScript, Second Edition, Understanding ECMAScript 6

specs.title: SCN-005: A search term that matches no book leaves no book rows

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page
When I type a term that matches no book
Then no book rows are listed

specs.title: SCN-006: A book's detail page shows its catalogue data

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page
[SEED] the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I click the title "Git Pocket Guide"
Then the detail page shows its ISBN, title, sub title, author, publisher and total pages as in the catalogue

specs.title: SCN-007: Adding books to my collection

steps.title: Given I am a test user with an empty collection
[SEED] account
When I POST /BookStore/v1/Books with two catalogue ISBNs
Then the answer is 201 and echoes the two ISBNs
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} lists both books

specs.title: SCN-008: A book added through the API appears on my Profile page

steps.title: Given I am a test user with "Git Pocket Guide" added through the API
[SEED] the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
[SEED] account
[SEED] add 9781449325862 to qa-existing-mulmm8w3-2's collection
When I sign in on /login and open my Profile
[SEED] sign in as qa-existing-mulmm8w3-2
Then "Git Pocket Guide" is listed with its title, author and publisher

specs.title: SCN-009: Adding a book that is already in my collection is refused

steps.title: Given I am a test user with "Git Pocket Guide" in my collection
[SEED] account
[SEED] add 9781449325862 to qa-existing-mulmm7gq-1's collection
When I POST /BookStore/v1/Books with it again
Then the answer is 400 with code "1210" and "ISBN already present in the User's Collection!"
And my collection contains it exactly once

specs.title: SCN-010: Deleting one book on the Profile page

steps.title: Given I am a test user with "Git Pocket Guide" and "Understanding ECMAScript 6" in my collection, signed in on /login
[SEED] account
[SEED] add 9781449325862, 9781593277574 to qa-existing-mulmm7gq-1's collection
[SEED] sign in as qa-existing-mulmm7gq-1
When I press the delete icon of "Git Pocket Guide" and confirm "Do you want to delete this book?" with OK
Then its row is gone and "Understanding ECMAScript 6" remains
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} no longer lists "Git Pocket Guide" and still lists "Understanding ECMAScript 6"

specs.title: SCN-011: Removing one book through the API

steps.title: Given I am a test user with two books in my collection
[SEED] account
[SEED] add 9781449325862, 9781593277574 to qa-existing-mulmm8w3-2's collection
When I DELETE /BookStore/v1/Book for one of them
Then the answer is 204
And the other book remains in my collection

specs.title: SCN-012: Removing a book that is not in my collection is refused

steps.title: Given I am a test user with an empty collection
[SEED] account
When I DELETE /BookStore/v1/Book for a catalogue book
Then the answer is 400 with code "1206" and "ISBN supplied is not available in User's Collection!"

specs.title: SCN-013.1: An ISBN that is not in the catalogue is refused (look it up with GET /BookStore/v1/Book)

steps.title: Given I am a test user with an empty collection
[SEED] account
When I look it up with GET /BookStore/v1/Book with an ISBN that is not in the catalogue
Then the answer is 400 with code "1205" and "ISBN supplied is not available in Books Collection!"
And nothing is added to my collection

specs.title: SCN-013.2: An ISBN that is not in the catalogue is refused (add it with POST /BookStore/v1/Books)

steps.title: Given I am a test user with an empty collection
[SEED] account
When I add it with POST /BookStore/v1/Books with an ISBN that is not in the catalogue
Then the answer is 400 with code "1205" and "ISBN supplied is not available in Books Collection!"
And nothing is added to my collection

specs.title: SCN-014.1: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (adds a book to A's collection without a token)

steps.title: Given two test users, A and B
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
When a client adds a book to A's collection without a token
Then the answer is 401 with code "1200" and "User not authorized!"

specs.title: SCN-014.2: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (deletes a book from A's collection without a token)

steps.title: Given two test users, A and B
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
[SEED] add 9781449325862 to qa-existing-mulmm8w3-2's collection
When a client deletes a book from A's collection without a token
Then the answer is 401 with code "1200" and "User not authorized!"

specs.title: SCN-014.3: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (reads A's collection without a token)

steps.title: Given two test users, A and B
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
When a client reads A's collection without a token
Then the answer is 401 with code "1200" and "User not authorized!"

specs.title: SCN-014.4: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (reads B's collection with A's token)

steps.title: Given two test users, A and B
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
When a client reads B's collection with A's token
Then the answer is 401 with code "1200" and "User not authorized!"

specs.title: SCN-014.5: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (adds a book to B's collection with A's token)

steps.title: Given two test users, A and B
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
When a client adds a book to B's collection with A's token
Then the answer is 401 with code "1200" and "User not authorized!"
